Set `--tblr-number-input-input-width` on the input for longer values. [Input] `` ### Disabled Add `disabled` or `readonly` to the input; both buttons follow. [Input] `` ### Validation Add `.is-valid` or `.is-invalid` to the input, the same way you would on any `.form-control`. The field is too narrow for the validation icon, so only the border changes colour.
